A '''chocolate chip cookie''' is a [[chocolate]] meal that heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/chocolate_chip_cookie.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Chocolate, sugar and dough. Obtaining chocolate unlocks the recipe. The vanilla cookie recipe is removed; the vanilla cookie item is the pack's [[cheese]].

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a cookie takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Haste I for 5:00.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_9.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
